comment: Catalogue of models that are not shipped in the release (D8). Everything
permissively licensed is already in models/; what is listed here either is
too large to ship or carries a licence the user has to accept first.
The sha256 values are the Hugging Face LFS object ids, which are the
SHA-256 of the file contents. They were read from the repository API, not
computed locally, so they can be regenerated without downloading anything:

models.name: sd15
models.description: Stable Diffusion 1.5 base checkpoint, required by the diffusion algorithm

models.name: ip-adapter-sd15
models.description: IP-Adapter for SD 1.5: turns the style image into an image prompt (D7)

models.name: clip-vision
models.description: CLIP ViT-H/14 image encoder, the vision tower IP-Adapter feeds the style image through

postprocess.comment: Works around an upstream bug (D24): stable-diffusion.cpp drops every tensor whose name starts with 'vision_model.' while loading ANY file, which empties this encoder completely. The filter runs before the loader adds its own 'clip_vision.' prefix, and names that already carry that prefix are left alone, so prefixing here both dodges the filter and lands the tensors where the loader expects them. Header-only rewrite; the weights are copied through untouched. Remove once the upstream fix lands.
